description: The Atlantis expedition reaches the lost Ancient city in Pegasus, awakens the Wraith and struggles to establish allies and a defensible home while cut off from Earth.

s01e01-02.description: The expedition arrives in Atlantis, discovers the city beneath an ocean and accidentally awakens the Wraith while rescuing Athosian survivors.

s01e03.description: McKay becomes trapped inside an Ancient personal shield while a strange energy creature begins feeding on the city's power.

s01e04.description: A puddle jumper becomes lodged in the Stargate with only thirty-eight minutes before shutdown, while Sheppard's condition rapidly worsens.

s01e05.description: Repeated Wraith encounters make the expedition suspect an Athosian traitor, threatening Teyla's people's place in Atlantis.

s01e06.description: Sheppard's team finds a society where no one lives past twenty-five and discovers the disturbing reason the Wraith leave the settlement alone.

s01e07.description: Hoffan scientists develop a drug intended to make humans poisonous to the Wraith, but its lethal cost divides the Atlantis team and their hosts.

s01e08.description: Seeking food, the expedition discovers the apparently agrarian Genii are secretly building a military capable of striking the Wraith.

s01e09.description: A powerful energy source appears to offer a route back to Earth, but the homecoming becomes increasingly impossible to reconcile with reality.

s01e10.description: As a catastrophic storm forces Atlantis to evacuate, the Genii exploit the crisis to seize the city and take Weir and McKay hostage.

s01e11.description: Sheppard fights through the Genii occupation while McKay races to use the storm's lightning to protect Atlantis from destruction.

s01e12.description: A survey mission strands Sheppard and McKay with an awakened Wraith survivor who has been trapped alone for thousands of years.

s01e13.description: An Ancient nanovirus spreads through Atlantis and kills seemingly at random, forcing a lockdown while Beckett searches for its trigger.

s01e14.description: Sheppard grows close to Chaya, the guardian of a peaceful world whose extraordinary protection conceals an Ancient secret.

s01e15.description: The team discovers an elderly Elizabeth Weir in stasis, carrying memories of an alternate expedition whose failure changed Atlantis's fate.

s01e16.description: The team searches for a hidden ZPM once protected by an old human brotherhood, only to find the treasure hunt has surviving guardians.

s01e17.description: With a Wraith fleet approaching, Atlantis sends a compressed transmission to Earth while its members record messages they may never get to deliver.

s01e18.description: Teyla discovers her unsettling connection to the Wraith comes from experiments performed on her ancestors and tries to use it against the enemy.

s01e19.description: Atlantis prepares for the incoming Wraith armada and gambles on an Ancient defense satellite as its last chance to stop the fleet.

s01e20.description: The siege begins as Earth sends reinforcements and the expedition considers destroying Atlantis rather than letting the Wraith capture it intact.
